title: Entity change history
responsibility: Builds ancestor-only history and reads exact-revision source measurements independently of verification records.

inputs.name: explorerHistory.index
inputs.description: History index with revision summaries, unit growth and reviews.

inputs.name: explorerHistory.scope
inputs.description: Resolved scope whose commit bounds the ancestry search.

inputs.name: explorerHistory.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier whose direct changes are listed.

inputs.name: historyDetail.detail
inputs.description: Stored revision to inspect for this entity.

inputs.name: historyDetail.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier to inspect in that revision.

outputs.name: explorerHistory
outputs.description: Newest-first rows for the shown commit and known ancestors that directly changed, added or removed the entity, plus rows whose change status is unknown. Each retains first-parent identity, measured values, changes from the preceding retained measurement and reviews at that commit. Known unchanged or indirectly affected commits are omitted.

outputs.name: historyDetail
outputs.description: Whether registry/impact information is available, active presence, change mark, version, matching explanations and the entity verdict when present.
